overloads.semanticRole: The Print form command simply prints form with the current values of fields and variables of aTable .

jointConstraints.rule: If both aTable and form are passed alone (areaStart/areaEnd omitted), only the Detail area of the form is printed. If only areaStart is passed, it is treated as a Form Area theme marker constant (e.g. Form header, Form detail, Form footer) selecting a named section to print. If both areaStart and areaEnd are passed, they are pixel offsets delimiting an arbitrary section of the form to print, overriding the single-marker interpretation of areaStart.

constraints: Does not perform record processing, break processing, or page breaks; the caller is responsible for those.
Does not issue a page break after printing, so multiple forms/tables can be combined onto the same page; use PAGE BREAK to force one.

Builds each page in memory; you must call PAGE BREAK to flush/print the final page, except when running inside an OPEN PRINTING JOB, where PAGE BREAK must NOT be called for the last page (CLOSE PRINTING JOB prints it automatically; calling PAGE BREAK anyway prints a blank page).
Printer dialog boxes never appear; print settings must be set beforehand via PRINT SETTINGS (interactive) or SET PRINT OPTION/GET PRINT OPTION (programmatic).
Only the On Printing Detail form event is generated; subforms are not printed (use PRINT RECORD for subforms).
The returned height is the printed area's height, and is what Get printed height reports.
formData properties become available in the form context via the Form command during the On Printing Detail event.
